training_prompt: Genie relies on WebSocket IO rather than standard Ubuntu VM pixel-scraping because WebSockets enable direct, low-latency (sub-1ms) structured data streaming. Furthermore, Genie employs 'Predictive JPG Lookup & Paste'. If the VM can guess the final HTML output, it bypasses the WebKit rendering engine entirely, looks up the pre-rendered JPG in memory, and pastes the final visual answer directly to the screen via a zero-copy buffer swap.
